ewaldbackground.help: Converges the self-consistent polarized background of a periodic system with Ewald summation

multipoles.help: MPS mapping file (xml) of the system

checkpoint.help: HDF5 file for the converged background (used by qmmm Ewald regions)

alpha.help: Ewald splitting parameter; derived from the box and screening_factor if not set

k_max.help: Reciprocal-space cutoff; derived from alpha and screening_factor if not set

shape.help: Shape of the macroscopic sample (surface term): cube or sphere (same term), or slab

r_min.help: Real-space sum over periodic images: minimal shell radius before convergence may be declared

field_tol.help: Real-space sum: convergence threshold on the field contribution of one shell (atomic units)

screening_factor.help: Accuracy of the Ewald sums (dimensionless): sets the real-space cutoff screening_factor/alpha and a reciprocal cutoff with the same error (erfc(screening_factor)); lower it only deliberately

induce.help: Compute induced dipoles (false: static multipoles only)

max_iter.help: Maximal number of iterations of the induction solver

tolerance.help: Convergence tolerance of the induction solver

use_jor.help: Use Jacobi over-relaxation (as the legacy code) instead of preconditioned conjugate gradients

use_block_jacobi_preconditioner.help: Block-Jacobi (per segment) preconditioner for the conjugate gradient solver

debug_match_legacy_first_step.help: Debugging: replicate the two-phase first step of the legacy code
